high_level_overview.overview: The COMBTRAN job combines and consolidates credit card transaction data from two sources: a backup of the current transaction file and a system-generated transactions file. It sorts the merged transactions by Transaction ID in ascending order and writes the result to a new generation of a combined transaction dataset. Finally, it loads the combined and sorted transaction data into a VSAM KSDS (Key-Sequenced Dataset), which serves as the transaction master file for the CardDemo credit card application.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The job name that uniquely identifies this job to the system. It is used for tracking, scheduling, and referencing the job in the JES queue.

parameters.name: ACCOUNTING INFORMATION
parameters.description: The first positional parameter on the JOB statement, providing accounting or descriptive information for the job. It is used for billing, documentation, and identification purposes.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class, which determines the job entry subsystem (JES) input queue where the job is placed. Class A typically indicates a standard batch processing class, affecting scheduling priority and resource allocation.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log and system messages (JES message log). This determines where the job's system output messages are routed, such as to a printer, held queue, or sysout class.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified upon job completion or failure. The symbolic parameter &SYSUID resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, sending a notification message when the job finishes.

job_details.purpose: Sorts and combines the current transaction backup file and system-generated transactions into a single output file. Records are sorted in ascending order by the Transaction ID field (TRAN-ID), defined as a 16-character field starting at position 1.
job_details.inputs: SORTIN: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP(0) (current transaction backup), AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN(0) (system-generated transactions); SYMNAMES: TRAN-ID field definition (position 1, length 16, character); SYSIN: SORT FIELDS=(TRAN-ID,A)
job_details.outputs: SORTOUT: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.COMBINED(+1) (new generation, cataloged, SYSDA, space 1 cylinder with 1 secondary, release unused; DCB copied from SORTIN); SYSOUT: job log

job_details.purpose: Loads the combined and sorted transaction file into the VSAM KSDS transaction master dataset by reproducing all records from the sequential combined file into the VSAM dataset.
job_details.inputs: TRANSACT: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.COMBINED(+1) (combined sorted transaction file produced in STEP05R)
job_details.outputs: TRANVSAM: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS (VSAM KSDS transaction master, updated via REPRO); SYSPRINT: utility execution report

data_operations.description: SORT reads the current generation (0) of the transaction backup file as first input dataset
SORT reads the current generation (0) of the system-generated transactions file as second input dataset
SORT writes the combined and sorted output (sorted ascending by TRAN-ID, characters 1-16) to a new generation (+1) of the combined transactions GDG dataset, newly cataloged on SYSDA
IDCAMS REPRO reads the newly created combined transactions dataset as input (INFILE)
IDCAMS REPRO loads all records from the combined transactions dataset into the VSAM KSDS transaction master file as output (OUTFILE)
